fluff.overview: The Armed Forces of the Federated Suns integrate conventional infantry directly into their Regimental Combat Teams, assigning foot, mechanized, and jump platoons to work permanently alongside BattleMech and armored formations. Foot infantry remain the backbone of AFFS planetary garrisons, cheap enough to deploy in numbers across the Federated Suns' vast territory and reliable enough to hold ground that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. These marines are trained to fight equally well in zero-gravity and conventional ground environments, conducting shipboard security, boarding actions, and combat in vacuum or pressurized hull conditions with laser weapons suited to close-quarters shipboard engagements.
